This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.271/2023, dated 01.08.2023 registered at Police Station Baheriya,
District Sagar (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366A, 376, 376(2)(n)(f) of IPC and Section 3/4, 5(L)(N)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Applicant is in detention since 21.08.2023.
2. As per the prosecution story, on 01.08.2023, prosecutrix's father lodged an FIR about missing of his daughter aged 16 years 10 months and a student of Class XII.
FIR was registered.
Almost after twenty days on 21.08.2023 prosecutrix was recovered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed for aforesaid offences.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant and prosecutrix were having love affairs.

sentences.text: Prosecutrix on her own had gone with the applicant.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed grant of bail.
5 . In this case, prosecutrix and her parents have already been examined before the trial Court.
They have not supported the prosecution story.

Considering the material on record including prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Rampal urf Kuldeep Vishvakarma be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
